{{pov|[[Graendal]]}}

Graendal visits [[Sammael]]'s rooms in [[Illian]] and is amazed at the items he has found from the [[Age of Legends]]. He hints that he has found something powerful, which Graendal suspects means he has an ''[[angreal]]'' or ''[[sa'angreal]]''.{{ref|It is actually a ''[[gholam]]''.}} Sammael claims he now has a truce with [[Rand]]. Sammael wants to know where the other [[Forsaken]] are. Graendal states that [[Asmodean]]{{ref|Graendal's knowledge of his death (here and more obliquely in [[Lord of Chaos/Chapter 6|Chapter 6]]), missed by many readers, was her first confession to his murder!}} and [[Lanfear]] are dead and [[Moghedien]] probably is, too. [[Mesaana]] is in the [[White Tower]]. Graendal does not know where any of the others are. Sammael hints that the Great Lord has promised him the position of [[Nae'blis]] and tells Graendal to find where the others are so he can point Rand at them.

{{pov|[[Sammael]]}}

Sammael plans to do whatever he must to survive and become Nae'blis and defeat Rand in the [[Last Battle]].
